source.note: Canonical BARS routing cut derived from the 370-skill audit. Archive/template-spam families are intentionally excluded from live routing.

make-a-plan.reach_for: Start any build task by writing the approach before code.

spec-drafting.reach_for: Turn a fuzzy idea into the smallest buildable version with acceptance criteria.

spike.reach_for: Run a throwaway experiment before committing to a risky implementation.

systematic-debugging.reach_for: Find root cause with a tight failing/passing loop before fixing.

simplify-code.reach_for: Make code smaller and clearer without changing behavior.

security-sweep.reach_for: Check secrets, injection, authentication and authorization with demonstrated findings.

pre-commit-verification.reach_for: Verify changes before commit, including an independent review pass.

adversarial-review-pass.reach_for: Try to break the work, refute findings, then report only surviving issues.

deploy-checklist.reach_for: Reproduce the build, fix the real deploy error and verify live runtime behavior.

source-triangulation.reach_for: Confirm load-bearing claims against independent sources.

creative-ideation.reach_for: Route creative work through a named method instead of first-thought lists.

voice-match.reach_for: Study the owner's real writing, name the voice and draft in it.

pare-humanize.reach_for: Remove AI patterns while preserving approved meaning and brand voice.

frontend-design.reach_for: Use one canonical frontend build skill instead of overlapping UI skill families.

html-ppt.reach_for: Use one deck engine with themes instead of many deck-template skills.

canvas-design.reach_for: Create posters and static visual compositions.

short-form-script.reach_for: Create beat-marked timed scripts in a natural spoken voice.

ugc-brief.reach_for: Create a shoot-ready brief with hooks, shot list and caption.

video-shortform.reach_for: Guide short-form video assembly and editing.

youtube-clipper.reach_for: Extract reusable clips from long-form video.

threejs.reach_for: Build interactive 3D experiences in the browser.

speech.reach_for: Generate text-to-speech through the selected speech provider.

client-presence-audit.reach_for: Produce a scored public-presence gap report with a phased strategy.

landing-copy.reach_for: Write a landing page for one audience, one promise and objections in sequence.

pitch-deck.reach_for: Build a sourced narrative deck around a clear commercial story.

lead-scouting.reach_for: Find qualified leads from public sources.

support-replies.reach_for: Answer in company voice and convert repeated answers into documentation.

commitment-tracking.reach_for: Track what the owner committed to and surface follow-through.

inbox-triage.reach_for: Turn inbox work into one board with held drafts and no automatic sends.

digest-composer.reach_for: Create recurring concise digests with citations for every factual claim.

feed-watch.reach_for: Watch a source and alert only when a defined bar is crossed.

relationship-log.reach_for: Keep durable records of people, context and promises.

work-splitting.reach_for: Split large jobs into bounded parallel agent pieces.

opportunity-scan.reach_for: Find monetizable openings matched to the owner's capabilities.

icm-pricing.reach_for: Require an evidence bar before pricing or selling an offer.

pare_spine.note: Keep the PARÉ system coherent; do not fragment or collapse it into unrelated generic skills.
